title: Daily Brief — Afternoon Edition — Monday, 21 September 2026
description: Today: Anthropic and Accenture announce an embedded-evaluator AI safety partnership; Chalmers releases an Intergenerational Report forecasting an AI-transformed economy as banks bring forward rate-move forecasts; Queensland Police graduates its largest officer intake of the year; and the Gold Coast's SWELL Sculpture Festival wraps up a successful run at Currumbin Beach. Broadcast in English, followed by a full Korean-language version (오늘의 브리핑 영어 방송 후 한국어 전체 브리핑이 이어집니다).

show.channel_description: A short daily news brief covering technology and AI, Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — made for your afternoon drive.
